name: 120% Lino
why: Linen clothing only — shirts, trousers, jackets — garment-dyed and made in Italy.

notes.linen: the category's only pure player — by its own CEO's boast, no competitor sells linen alone
notes.comfort: garment-dyed softness as the stated product
notes.ital: The name is a fabric specification, and the whole line follows from it. Linen from Italian spinners, cut loose, sold from the Sun Belt and the Ligurian coast — a single-fibre house rather than a designer who happens to use linen.
notes.boat: Linen cut for a coastline rather than a cabin. The register is the harbour town, not the passage.
